# Healthcare Quality Indicators

This folder contains healthcare quality indicators that track the safety, monitoring, and clinical standards of patient care within the Danish healthcare system. Currently, it houses a specific metric from the Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) that measures the proportion of patients on direct oral anticoagulants (DOAC) who receive their required annual kidney function tests. The pages detail national and regional performance against established clinical standards, highlighting geographic variations and the data infrastructure used to calculate these metrics at the municipality level.

## Pages

- [[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]] — Tracks the proportion of atrial fibrillation patients on DOAC therapy who receive an annual kidney function test, detailing national shortfalls and regional variations in meeting the ≥95% standard.
